title: 空間の量子 ― マニフェスト（第 I 巻、日本語訳） / Quanta of Space: A Manifesto (Japanese translation)
description:
DICTO『空間の量子 ― マニフェスト』第 I 巻（英語版第 2.1 版）の日本語訳。表紙：クォンタ・オブ・スペース。

Japanese translation of DICTO, Quanta of Space: A Manifesto, Volume I, Version 2.1 (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23754454). The original is unchanged.

subjects.term: MSC2020 51M20: Polyhedra and polytopes; regular figures, division of spaces

notes: Version 2.0: the whole translation checked for accuracy against the English Version 2.1, section by section (715 corrections: wrong solids, reversed statements, credits, numbers, leftover English); glossary terms applied throughout; contents rebuilt; translator's note on the Alice names (Chapter 6); katakana cover クォンタ・オブ・スペース.
